messages:
archie-iam: Quick alert  noticed after yesterday's RBAC tidy some SCIM jobs started 403ing for two tenants. Logs show KMS decrypt denied and idp introspect 401.

bev-sre: Can you paste minimal logs?

archie-iam: 
``
2026-03-26T02:21:10Z scim-provisioner ERROR decrypt: KMS PermissionDenied for projects/redwood/keys/provisioner-key
2026-03-26T02:21:12Z idp-proxy WARN introspect: 401 invalid_client
```

cam-sec: Likely the RBAC change removed the SA binding on the KMS key. Also confirm the key's IAM policy didn't get hardened in the same change.

dora-support: Impact: two customers blocked from onboarding, PS tickets opened. Any safe short-term fix?

bev-sre: Re-adding the kms:Decrypt binding for provisioner SA should be safe and quick. I'll run the revert in config and do a small rolling deploy.

kube-bot: deploy started by bev-sre:sha=deaf12 (rolling)

bev-sre: Revert applied and provisioner pods restarted. SCIM success and introspect now 200 for affected tenants.

archie-iam: Confirmed. Running audit to see who/what removed the binding.

cam-sec: Remediation items: 1) RBAC preflight that checks KMS key bindings; 2) CI test to simulate SCIM flow; 3) alert for simultaneous KMS decrypt failures + idp 4xx spike.

dora-support: I'll notify customers and keep tickets open until postmortem.

bev-sre: Closing the loop here. Good catch. :thumbsup:
